notes.title: Patch 1.25
notes.content:
Hello! Patch 1.25 have some QoL-features and bugfixes:

Dialog Skip. The most important and the most annoying thing. Now you can skip the dialog lines by pressing any button. Why it was not done before? Nobody knows

Some of you could may encounter the bug that let you clip through the walls. Well its some kind of physical engine bug and looks like i am not fully beat it yet but i make it harder to do

Fixed some neutral guys not reacting to you

Fixed bug when pause menu unlocks the camera during the dialog

Fixed some broken enemy paths

Other minor bigfixes
